arabic text: TUKDE KISI SHAHEED KA AISE BADAN NA HO\nGHATDI MEIN LAASH RAKHI HO LAIKIN KAFAN NA HO
english translation text: MAY THE CORPSE OF A MARTYR NEVER BE\nCHOPPED LIKE THIS\nTHAT THE CORPSE BE WRAPPED IN A SACK BUT HAVE NO SHROUD

arabic text: BEWA HASAN KI KAHTI THIS QASIM KE LAASH PER\nBETAA KISI KA IS TARHA MAAN SE JUDA NA HO
english translation text: THE WIDOW OF HASAN BEMOANED AT\nTHE CORPSE OF QASIM\nMAY NO SON EVER BE SEPARATED FROM HIS MOTHER IN SUCH A WAY

arabic text: JIS TARHA TUKDE LAASH-E-QASIM KE HOGAYE\nPAAMAL YUN JAHAAN MEIN LAASHA KIO NA HO
english translation text: AS CHOPPED AS THE CORPSE OF QASIM WAS\nMAY NO CORPSE IN THIS WORLD EVER BE MUTILATED

arabic text: GHURBAT MEIN YA KHUDA KOI SADMAA MILA NA HO\nPARDES MEIN YUN KISI SE BETA JUDA NA HO
english translation text:
O LORD! MAY NO ONE BE AFFLICTED BY
SUCH GRIEF IN A FOREIGN LAND
MAY NO ONE BE SEPARATED FROM HER SON
AWAY IN A FOREIGN LAND

arabic text: LUTAA GAYA HAI JIS TARHA GULSHAN RASOOL KA\nYA RAB TABAH ISS TARHA KOI CHAMAN NA HO
english translation text: AS THE PROPHET’S GARDENS WERE LOOTED\nO LORD! MAY NO GARDEN EVER BE LOOTED

arabic text: SARDAR-E-AMBIYA KE NAWASE KE WASTE\nUMMAT KE PAAS DENE KO DO GAZ KAFAN NA HO
english translation text:
FOR THE SAKE OF THE GRANDSON OF THE
MASTER OF PROPHETS
CAN THE NATION NOT SPARE TWO YARDS OF
CLOTH FOR A SHROUD?

arabic text: SAB KO LAHAD NASEEB HO SAB KO KAFAN MILE\nAFSOS DAFN LAASHA-E-SHAH-E-ZAMAN NA HO
english translation text: EVERYONE GETS A GRAVE,\nEVERYONE GETS A SHROUD\nWOE, BUT THE CORPSE OF THE MASTER OF THE TIMES REMAINS UNBURIED

arabic text: BACHA JO KAHIIN ROYA TO BAANU NE DI SADA\nLOGO KAHIIN YE ASGHAR-E-GUNCHA DAHAN NA HO
english translation text: WHEREVER A CHILD CRIED, BAANU CALLED OUT\nO PEOPLE! IS THIS NOT THE TOOTHLESS ASGHAR?
